name: Stocks
description: Stock quotes as a grid of cards, a board or a scrolling ticker. Quotes come from Finnhub through the server; the API key never reaches a screen.

schema.name: symbols
schema.label: Symbols
schema.help: Up to 20 ticker symbols separated by commas, for example AAPL, MSFT, BRK.B. Symbols that have not loaded yet show a dash.

schema.name: refresh
schema.label: Refresh (seconds)
schema.help: How often screens ask for new quotes. At least 60 seconds.

settings.name: delayed_label
settings.label: Show "Prices may be delayed"
settings.help: Adds the notice next to the "As of" time on every stocks slide.

terms: Quotes come from Finnhub (finnhub.io) and need a Finnhub API key, entered above or set in the AISIGNX_FINNHUB_KEY environment variable. Finnhub's free plan is for personal, non-commercial use. Showing quotes on public or business screens is redistribution and may need a paid Finnhub plan and exchange display licences. Stocks slides are not shown on screens until the key is set.
